peerReview.scope: Independent RK4 and finite charge/capacitance arithmetic only; not UI or full source review

authorVisualReview.distinction: Captured frames/DOM checks are not 64 manually inspected frames; only the listed images were actually opened.

automatedSilentTraversal.scope: Normal native clock, no seeking or time acceleration, silent. Automated traversal and sampled screenshots, not human continuous watching or subjective listening.
